Header-board Easter eggs: the final set (lane E3, rounds 4-8)

2026-11-27. All shots are the AGREED bar: board N-r8-01, Fraunces SemiBold Italic 24 name, the real app-icon tile, "Saved" + a timer count, account right. Phones now show the real cut-outs: the Dynamic Island (393) and the notch (390). Grades: B beauty, F believable food, L light, R readability, N noticeable (1-10 each, self, strict; the outside panel ran about 1 lower).

What changed in rounds 7-8 (the round-6 panel fixes)
  • Medium strength only; thyme + pepper cut. One faint/medium pair is kept below so you can compare.
  • Island and notch drawn; status-strip bits only beside or under them.
  • No food behind any word at any width: a keep-out map of the name, "Saved", the timer, the account, the clock and battery at every phone, iPad and web width. Measured: 0% of word pixels changed at all 11 shot widths.
  • On a phone the main group sits in the row's word-free top or bottom strip, right of the name, so it stays clear of "Saved" even at 320. Its spot, angle and spread differ per egg. 4-5 faint bits spread across the row.
  • Wide bars get a second group at hero strength mid-bar.
  • Chives in three greens with a few slant-cut tubes; white onion as solid uneven half-moons (a layer slipped out, warmer); red onion pieces kept apart with a deeper purple edge; parsley with a midrib, stem and lit edge; scallion as open rings.

Faint or medium? One pair to compare (chives, round 7)

Same egg, same layout. The panel and I pick medium: faint mostly disappears on a phone.

faint: E3-r7-01f 39/50 B7 F8 L9 R9 N6
medium: E3-r7-01m 40/50 B7 F8 L8 R9 N8

How often

One egg day in every block of 5 days, never back to back; the eggs take turns (chives, parsley, chives + onion, red onion, scallion). One year (2027): 73 egg days, longest wait 8 days, each egg 14-15 times; 0 back-to-back egg days in 10 years. Same on every device; changes at local midnight. Next egg days: 2026-11-30 Mon chives+onion, 2026-12-06 Sun red onion, 2026-12-08 Tue scallion, 2026-12-13 Sun chives, 2026-12-21 Mon parsley, 2026-12-25 Fri chives+onion. Full function: SCHEDULE.md.

E1 round 1

keep: chive rings read as rings at 3x; even and calm. Phone shows almost none (zone too wide).

keep: soft knife sweeps look like real prep, not confetti. Best of round 1.

fix: onion reads as grey-pink chips (white on orange wood goes grey). Warm it.

keep: chives + onion is the brief in one picture; onion needs the fix.

keep: parsley reads, but even spread looks a little like confetti.

cut: taco mix looks like a weaker parsley; red onion and lime do not read.
E1-r1-07 Thyme leaves + cracked pepper
keep: peppercorns read well; thyme too small to see.

fix: scallion reads as round water spots, not slices.

keep: parsley + chives + thyme is the most "real cooking" mix.

cut: knife marks are invisible at every size (old site kept them, 15 in 100).
